verdict.rationale: There is no dedicated bulk-operation feature. Jules's API lets users script custom workflows that create many sessions, and the usage-limits page lists high task and concurrency figures (300/60) for agent-heavy workflows. One user also reports it 'handles large quantities of tasks very well', so bulk work is possible through API scripting and parallel tasks rather than a native batch action. Missing for 10: a native bulk or batch operation (e.g. one task fanned out across many repos or issues), documentation of batch API endpoints, and hands-on evidence of bulk execution at scale.
